mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_arbitration_run (run_key, facts_hash, node_id, mission_kind, game_build, client_type, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, observed_seconds, drones, enemies, waves, rounds, completed, baseline_eligible, quality_flags, drones_per_minute, enemies_per_minute, full_bonus_vitus, full_bonus_vitus_per_hour, detail_rank, structured_gzip, parser_revision, first_saved_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{r.runKey}, #{r.factsHash}, #{r.nodeId}, #{r.missionKind}, #{r.gameBuild}, #{r.clientType}, #{r.startedAt}, #{r.endedAt}, #{r.durationSeconds}, #{r.observedSeconds}, #{r.drones}, #{r.enemies}, #{r.waves}, #{r.rounds}, #{r.completed}, #{r.baselineEligible}, #{r.qualityFlags}, #{r.dronesPerMinute}, #{r.enemiesPerMinute}, #{r.fullBonusVitus}, #{r.fullBonusVitusPerHour}, #{r.detailRank}, #{r.structuredGzip,jdbcType=LONGVARBINARY}, #{r.parserRevision}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE run_key=run_key
mapper.select: SELECT facts_hash AS factsHash, completed, observed_seconds AS observedSeconds, detail_rank AS detailRank FROM wf_arbitration_run WHERE run_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_arbitration_run SET facts_hash=#{r.factsHash}, node_id=#{r.nodeId}, mission_kind=#{r.missionKind}, game_build=#{r.gameBuild}, client_type=#{r.clientType}, started_at=#{r.startedAt}, ended_at=#{r.endedAt}, duration_seconds=#{r.durationSeconds}, observed_seconds=#{r.observedSeconds}, drones=#{r.drones}, enemies=#{r.enemies}, waves=#{r.waves}, rounds=#{r.rounds}, completed=#{r.completed}, baseline_eligible=#{r.baselineEligible}, quality_flags=#{r.qualityFlags}, drones_per_minute=#{r.dronesPerMinute}, enemies_per_minute=#{r.enemiesPerMinute}, full_bonus_vitus=#{r.fullBonusVitus}, full_bonus_vitus_per_hour=#{r.fullBonusVitusPerHour}, detail_rank=#{r.detailRank}, structured_gzip=#{r.structuredGzip,jdbcType=LONGVARBINARY}, parser_revision=#{r.parserRevision}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE run_key = #{r.runKey} AND completed = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_arbitration_upload (run_key, sender_key, platform, bot_id, message_type, user_id, first_uploaded_at, last_uploaded_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{senderKey}, #{u.platform}, #{u.botId}, #{u.messageType}, #{u.userId}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_uploaded_at=GREATEST(last_uploaded_at, VALUES(last_uploaded_at))

INSERT INTO wf_arbitration_last_file (sender_key, file_digest, manifest, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{senderKey}, #{fileDigest}, #{manifest}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_digest=VALUES(file_digest), manifest=VALUES(manifest), uploaded_at=VALUES(uploaded_at)
mapper.select: SELECT file_digest AS fileDigest, manifest FROM wf_arbitration_last_file WHERE sender_key = #{senderKey} AND OCTET_LENGTH(manifest) <= 32768

SELECT r.facts_hash AS factsHash, r.parser_revision AS parserRevision, r.detail_rank AS detailRank, r.has_conflict AS hasConflict, r.structured_gzip AS structuredGzip FROM wf_arbitration_run r INNER JOIN wf_arbitration_upload u ON u.run_key = r.run_key AND u.sender_key = #{senderKey} WHERE r.run_key = #{key} AND OCTET_LENGTH(r.structured_gzip) <= 1048576

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, r.run_key AS runKey, r.facts_hash AS factsHash, r.parser_revision AS parserRevision, r.detail_rank AS detailRank, r.has_conflict AS hasConflict, r.structured_gzip AS structuredGzip FROM wf_arbitration_run r INNER JOIN wf_arbitration_upload u ON u.run_key = r.run_key AND u.sender_key = #{senderKey} WHERE r.record_id = #{recordId} AND OCTET_LENGTH(r.structured_gzip) <= 1048576

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, r.node_id AS nodeId, r.mission_kind AS missionKind, r.client_type AS clientType, r.started_at AS startedAt, r.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, r.drones, r.enemies, r.completed, r.has_conflict AS hasConflict, r.full_bonus_vitus_per_hour AS fullBonusVitusPerHour FROM wf_arbitration_upload u INNER JOIN wf_arbitration_run r ON r.run_key = u.run_key WHERE u.sender_key = #{senderKey} ORDER BY r.started_at IS NULL, r.started_at, r.run_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
